properties.markdownProperty:
A **Meeting** records an elicitation session, review or any other project meeting. It has an automatically generated **Code** (`MEET-001`, `MEET-002`, ...), which cannot be edited. It records the *Date*, *Time* and *Place* of the meeting and the *Results* in Markdown.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **Yes**. It has the `traceable-object` class, so other objects can depend on a meeting to show where their information came from (it can also be the target of a symbolic link). - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**. *Authors*, *Sources* and *Attenders* point to stakeholders (*Attenders* uses the `:Proteus-information-source` trace type, like *Sources*), and *Dependencies* point to any traceable object.
